how: selfcheck first: 32 of 32 plants behaved. Four selections, each written to its own timestamped file: 37 units / 4 interval claims at 01:02Z, 39 / 5 at 01:36Z (c-46, a-80 landed), 41 / 6 at 01:56Z (c-47, a-81 landed), 41 / 6 at 02:10Z (closed). b-106 and the exclusion rule attacked by the run itself; c-42, c-43, c-44, c-46 and c-47 by one sub-agent each, and every adapter then RE-RUN by the run with its own exit code (all 0) and diffed against the sub-agent's log: c-42, c-44, c-46, c-47 identical apart from timing lines; c-43 identical apart from one budget-limited plant cell (51 against 27 reps). Every interval claim went through f26lib.duplication_through() with the target's own bootstrap.

verdicts.b-106: CITABLE (a count placed beside a null it carries; b-106 computed no estimate, so step 4 does not apply, step 3 does not apply to a graded record, and the through-the-target blocks test was NOT RUN - the interval is computed by the site in TypeScript). '481 of the 496 graded leans carry a valid price' reproduces under this run's own rule (finite, |price| >= 100, the rule b-106's lib/ledger.ts validPrice states) on the local Board ledger AND on the ledger production served at 2026-10-09 01:05Z (same sha256 86b6e03fa0f0): 496 graded, 256 cleared, 240 missed; 15 not valid, 7 in week 3 and 8 in week 4, every one strictly inside (-100, +100), none null. The carried rate 51.6% [47.2, 56.0] reproduces as a per-lean Wilson interval; re-drawn here under game blocks (31) it is [46.9, 56.1] and under player-game blocks (368) [46.6, 56.6], 0.5 inside every one, 0.25 of its MDE (2.8 x game-block SE = 6.5 points). Scope: NFL 2026 weeks 3-4, the ledger of 2026-10-08; every count moves at the next grading. Power: the record could not have told a true rate of 50% from one under about 56.5%. NOT CHECKED: what the page renders (b-106 is unmerged; no page was fetched or photographed here) and whether each lean was published before kickoff (a-57's rule). Outside the sentence: the 15 cleared 5 of 15 against 251 of 481 (52.2% [47.7, 56.6]) for the rest; a-80 traced their cause and this run did not re-derive it.
verdicts.c-42: CITABLE ONLY WITH A STATED SENTENCE, from its rows (pipeline NOT re-run, LEAKAGE NOT RUN, kickoff-slot blocks NOT RUN - no kickoff time in the rows; the cache it was re-derived from is the unit's uncommitted scratch). All 48 tests recomputed through counterfactual_uncertainty.slice_tests at its seed: 0 differ at 1e-9; 97.4% / 98.0%, T1 +0.640 [+0.615, +0.658], T2 -0.006 [-0.036, +0.022], 466 of 468, 3.1 SE and 26.0% all reproduce. Honours game blocks through slice_tests (477 rows, 31 games counted here: x1.000 on copies); T2 contains zero under player, player-game and team blocks. Specifications: 1 as far as git and scratch reach (script unchanged after 90edc7d; one result set); the result file's 'specifications_tried: 1' is a typed literal. What does not hold is the power sentence: the finding's 'could have seen a missed-against-cleared difference of 0.04' - a difference of 0.041 planted through the unit's own 48-test family is detected in 59-65% of 600 replicates unadjusted and 16-19% under its registered Holm rule; 80% needs about 0.06 unadjusted and about 0.13 under Holm. 'None of 24 tests' is 5 distinct tests: 14 enter at p = 1 on a zero-variance bootstrap and the other 10 are 5 exact mirror pairs, all on one set of 11 rows. Sentence: 'On c-40's 477 NFL Board leans (ledger snapshot 2026-10-08T20:16Z, 2026 weeks 3-4, 31 games, three of five inputs, sampling standard errors only) the player's own prior mean is the flipping input on 97.4% of missed and 98.0% of cleared leans. That is the model's arithmetic: the registered inequality predicts the flipping input on 468 of 468 rows where it is defined, and the observed difference sits at the 48th percentile of the within-game label-permutation null. The missed-minus-cleared difference of -0.006 [-0.036, +0.022] rests on the 11 rows where own mean is not the flipping input, 9 of them players with too little history for own mean to have a standard error. A difference of 0.041 would have been detected about 60-65% of the time unadjusted and 16-19% under the unit's Holm rule; an excess of own mean on misses above +0.020 cannot occur on these rows. Leakage not tested; the line and the weight not measured.'
verdicts.c-43: CITABLE ONLY WITH A STATED SENTENCE, from c-35's extract cache (D:/temp/c35/rows.json, sha256 1c5f8b26..., the hash the pre-registration names; the extract was NOT re-run, the store NOT opened, so cache-against-store is NOT CHECKED and LEAKAGE is NOT RUN; the cache carries no quote or kickoff time, so 'read at kickoff - 180 min' is not checkable from it). All 29 checked figures reproduce through the target's own functions, including 0 of 11,145 negative, 6 of 46 BH survivors, -2.85pp [-5.07, -0.81], -3.64pp [-7.62, +0.26] and +2.06c [+1.94, +2.17]. All four interval claims honour game blocks through interval_mass.boot_mean (cost: 3,599 pairs on 18 games, x1.000 on copies). What does not travel bare: (1) '6 of 46 survive BH' depends on the denominator - over the 72 registered cells with the 22 absent entered at p = 1, one survives, and it is the zero-hit cell (22 intervals, z -34 on the bootstrap SE, -1.36 on an outcome-independent one); (2) the registered verdict word comes out in 35% of 80 simulated seasons in which the ladder is priced exactly right, through the target's own calibration(), so the word does not separate this run from a calibrated market (six or more survivors: 0 of 80); (3) receptions width 3 sits at its own MDE (0.94 of 2.8 SE) and contains zero under kickoff-date blocks (9): [-4.37, +1.56]; (4) the cost difference is positive on 98.4% of pairs and 18 of 18 games - two legs cost more than one almost by construction - and the informative figure is the ratio, 1.90 single rungs (two-leg minus twice a single: -0.24c [-0.32, -0.16]). Specifications: one registered run plus addendum 1 (post hoc, disclosed); f26lib.registered_count refuses on this file (no registered_intervals.count); 72 and 9 were read from its own keys. Sentence: 'Kalshi KXNFLREC / KXNFLRSHATT, NFL 2026 weeks 2-4, one read per game, 48 games: an interval between two rungs is coherent (0 of 11,145 negative) and no cell is shown mispriced at a median MDE of 7.7pp (3.4pp for receptions width 3 pooled, about 6pp for intervals straddling the centre). The six BH survivors are one over the 72 registered cells and none on an outcome-independent standard error, and a ladder priced exactly right returns this verdict in about a third of simulated seasons. Buying an interval costs 1.9 times the nearest single rung at 100 contracts (+2.06c [+1.94, +2.17]) on 18 games, 16 of them week 3. The same 48 games as c-35; cache against store and quote timing not checked.' NOT RUN: plants at s = 1.067, 1.25 and 1.40 (budget); the s = 1.15 cell is budget-limited and its rep count differed between the two runs (51 and 27 reps: 'mispriced' 0.78 in both).
verdicts.c-44: FOUR CLAIMS, pipeline re-run on today's stores (both mode=ro through the target's own connect functions; 1,142 numeric leaves against the committed JSON, 0 differ, on an nfl_games rebuilt since the run), leakage RUN with plants that fire (scramble at two cutoffs per sport: 0 of 1,869 / 3,871 NFL and 0 of 4,954 / 10,640 college earlier forecasts moved; truncated refit of k, r, a, b equal in 21 of 21 seasons in each sport). NOT RUN: nothing the adapter set out to do; NOT VERIFIED by anything on disk: that kickoff stamps are right to within the hours the 6-hour as-of rule leans on. (i) THE ORDERING - model beats pair mean beats league mean, both sports and college re-weighted: CITABLE. Survives season blocks and Bonferroni over all 74 registered intervals; scope is one scores-only model against two naive baselines, 2005-2025, 5,698 NFL and 15,508 FBS-FBS games; it is not c-31's model and it loses to the price. (ii) THE PAIR-MEAN GAP +0.0183 [+0.0110, +0.0258]: CITABLE. Season blocks [+0.0093, +0.0282], Bonferroni over 74, 1.72x its MDE, +0.0182 to +0.0191 under three unregistered re-binnings. (iii) THE LEAGUE-MEAN REMAINDER +0.0134 [+0.0008, +0.0265]: the figure reproduces; the reading 'a remainder exists' and the figure '83% of the gap is the spread of environments' are NOT CITABLE bare. Scope: this model, eight registered bins of e, 2005-2025. Power: 0.72 of its MDE (stated 0.0187, re-measured 0.0186). It contains zero under season blocks (21 a sport): [-0.0039, +0.0308]; it does not survive Bonferroni over the 17 primary tests (0.755) - its Holm p equals its raw p only because it is the largest of the 17; under other bins it is +0.0098 [-0.0021, +0.0226] to +0.0388 [+0.0256, +0.0520] and the share removed runs 50% to 83%, because the two open-ended bins do not match on e (mean e -6.9 / +7.0 NFL against -8.5 / +9.2 college). Sentence: 'Re-weighted to the NFL's eight registered bins of game environment, college's skill advantage over the league-and-season mean falls from +0.0794 to +0.0134; that remainder is below its own MDE, contains zero under season blocks, and moves between +0.010 and +0.039 with the binning, so neither that a gap remains nor that 83% of it is the spread is established.' (iv) THE PRICE LOSSES: CITABLE ONLY WITH A STATED SENTENCE: 'The college price is CFBD's last value and not a timestamped close; the two losses are not comparable between sports.' The NFL figure is +9.58 [+7.15, +12.07] in the result file; the findings doc and CLAUDE.md entry print +9.59 and +12.08, a three-decimal log figure rounded a second time. Honours blocks only as a row bootstrap with one row a game (rows == games, counted here).
verdicts.c-46: CITABLE ONLY WITH A STATED SENTENCE, from its rows (LEAKAGE NOT RUN and the 19 recovered fits NOT re-derived - both need the facts store; read_at against a kickoff NOT CHECKED, the rows carry no kickoff time; kickoff-slot blocks NOT RUN; a plant with own mean MORE often on misses NOT RUN). All 80 tests recomputed through counterfactual_population.analyse at its seed: 0 differ at 1e-9; 496, 240 / 256, 31 games, 19 recovered, 12 of 477 broken, 67.5% / 68.8%, -0.012 [-0.102, +0.076], p 0.785, -0.019 / p 0.738 on the 477, 58.5th [57.6, 59.5] / 62.6% all reproduce. Honours game blocks through slice_tests (x1.000 on copies); contains zero under player, player-game, ladder and team blocks; permuting whole ladders within game leaves the null standing (p 0.76 and 0.92; 356 of 425 ladders are one rung). Stated MDE 0.121 is consistent with 2.8 x the game-block SE (0.125). Specifications: 80 registered, 30 at p = 1 on a zero-variance permutation, at most 26 distinct live tests; three executions in scratch where the findings say two - run 1 differs from the committed file only by three added descriptive keys, runs 2 and 3 are byte-identical, no reported figure changed. What the sentence must carry is power: the registered three-part rule called a planted difference of 0.121 'diagnostic' on own mean in 25% of 20 exact-rule replicates (bracket 30-66% over 200), and reaches 80% at about 0.18. Sentence: 'On the NFL Board ledger snapshot of 2026-10-08 (2026 weeks 3-4, 31 games, 496 graded leans, c-40's proportional ranking, 19 of the fits recovered under an ingestion-time rule that also breaks 12 of the other 477) own mean is the flipping input on 67.5% of missed and 68.8% of cleared leans: missed minus cleared -0.012 [-0.102, +0.076], within-game permutation p 0.785. The registered rule would have called a true difference of about 0.18 diagnostic 80% of the time and one of 0.121 between a quarter and two-thirds of the time, so this rules out a difference of roughly 0.18 or more, not one of 0.12.' The unit's report says the pre-stated MDE was '1.5x to 2.4x' the realised one; the rows give 1.52 to 2.46.
verdicts.c-47: CITABLE ONLY WITH A STATED SENTENCE, ROWS-IN from the unit's scratch rows of 2026-10-08 21:33 EDT (rows against the store NOT CHECKED; store-level leakage NOT RUN - function-level only, three plants fire; the unit's 600-rep simulation not redrawn; team_total's undated input not compared with a timestamped line; season blocks NOT READ, 3 blocks). All 98 tests (84 registered) recomputed through the target's own analyse and verdict: 0 differ at 1e-9; 0 of 12 cells, 0 of 84 after Holm, every named figure and all 12 states reproduce. Honours game blocks through coef_test and brier_test (x1.000 on copies; 4,581 rungs on 806 games, 10,527 on 813); no coarser block widens an interval. 98 = 84 registered + 8 descriptive Brier arms + 6 no-QB coefficients; script unchanged after the power commit; no outcome-joined estimate in scratch before it. The unit's power figures, which it calls simulated upper bounds, are NOT overstated in the slot tested: a candidate of known size planted on the real rows through the target's own rule is detected 12% / 45% / 80% of the time in receptions and 1% / 10% / 23% in rush attempts at 0.020 / 0.033 / 0.045 per sd (200 replicates a cell), inside its stated ranges. A true 0.020 effect is never falsely excluded in receptions line_pos (0 of 100). The one thing its wording does not carry: the single 'ruled out at 0.020' state recurs in 71 of 100 game resamples of the same rows. Sentence: 'On NFL receptions and rush-attempt overs, regular season 2023-2025, against the de-vigged DK/FD/MGM bench price about 14 minutes before kickoff, none of c-41's six linear candidates was detected (0 of 12 cells, 0 of 84 tests after Holm). The detection rule sees an effect of 0.020 per sd 12% of the time in receptions and 1% in rush attempts, and one of 0.045 80% and 23%. An effect of 0.020 is excluded in one cell of twelve (receptions line_pos), a state that recurs in 71 of 100 resamples of the same games; rush-attempts form_gap (+0.0201 [+0.0033, +0.0368], Holm p 1.00) is unresolved at every size.' The unit's own summary already says most of this; the sentence adds the 71.
